# Passage text removed from the compositional split

As for the 2WikiMultiHop splits in `aug2026_original/swap/data/` (see `PASSAGE_TEXT_REMOVED.md` there), the passage text of this split is not included: `passages.jsonl` is left out, and in `manifest.json` each record's `abstract` is emptied and followed by `abstract_sha256` (SHA-256 of the removed UTF-8 text) and `abstract_n_chars`. `code/make_comp200.py` rebuilds `passages.jsonl` and the full `manifest.json` from the 2WikiMultiHop development set (`data_ids/dev.json`; command in `oct2026_additions/README.md`). The retrieval and answer statistics of this split recompute from the frozen per-question vectors (`_kgswap_*.json`) and the reader outputs without the text; the corpus checks of `results/twowiki_comp200_summary.*` need the rebuilt passages.
